customize.css: @media (min-width: 1100px) { html:has(.credits) main { box-sizing: border-box; width: min(100%, 1160px); max-width: 1160px; padding-right: 320px; } main:has(.credits) .credits { position: fixed; top: 8vh; right: max(24px, calc((100vw - 1160px) / 2 + 24px)); box-sizing: border-box; width: 260px; max-height: 84vh; overflow-y: auto; margin: 0; padding: 1.2rem; border: 1px solid rgba(127, 127, 127, .35); border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(127, 127, 127, .08); } } .wc-embed > a { display: none; }
